link.note: Named as Pietro's father in Pietro's 1901 death act and in the 1869 birth act ('Pietro Petriello fu Angelo'); also in daughter Gaetana's 1855 marriage index.

summary: John's maternal 4th great-grandfather; earliest known Petriello ancestor, of Guardia Lombardi.
bio: New generation found in Round 2 (FS tree) and confirmed Round 3. 'Fu Angelo' in the 1869 birth act of his grandson John means he was dead by 25 Oct 1869. Wife Lucia Marra. Daughter Gaetana married Giuseppantonio Lucadamo 23 Feb 1855 (index 1855 #16), where he appears as 'Angiolo'.
openQuestions: Birth, marriage and death acts (Guardia; death before 1869)
